name: treasury_strategies
description: Deposit-to-claimed-withdrawal lifecycle on contracts/treasury-strategies (admin = the harness admin actor, treasury = the deployed multisig, one 100%-cap strategy backed by the mock adapter, 10-ledger withdrawal cooldown): fund the treasury, deposit into a strategy, request a withdrawal, reject an early claim (WithdrawalNotYetClaimable), claim once the cooldown has elapsed, then pin the rejected double claim (WithdrawalAlreadyClaimed) and an over-allocation request (InsufficientAllocation). The mock adapter accrues 5% APY, but over these few ledgers the interest rounds to zero, so every balance below is exact.

steps.description: strategy 1: up to 100% of the treasury's balance may be allocated to it
no funds have reached a strategy yet
600 left the treasury for the strategy
withdrawal 1 becomes claimable at ledger 14 (4 + 10 cooldown)
requesting a withdrawal deallocates it immediately
claim before the cooldown has elapsed
the rejected early claim moved no funds
the 200 claimed returns to the treasury
600 minus the 200 that was paid out
over-allocation: only 400 is still allocated to strategy 1
the rejected request left the allocation untouched
